recordLookups.name: Get_ChangeRequest
recordLookups.description: Retrieves the ChangeRequest record by recordId to display context fields on the triage screen
recordLookups.label: Get ChangeRequest

recordUpdates.name: Update_ChangeRequest_Scope
recordUpdates.description: Updates the ChangeRequest record's Scope_Type__c field with the value selected by the reviewer on the triage screen
recordUpdates.label: Update ChangeRequest Scope

screens.name: Triage_Screen
screens.description: Displays read-only ChangeRequest context fields and captures user input for Scope_Type__c determination
screens.label: Triage Screen

fields.name: crDescription
fields.description: Display-only field showing the Description from the retrieved ChangeRequest record

fields.name: crOrigin
fields.description: Display-only field showing the Origin__c from the retrieved ChangeRequest record

fields.name: crRequester
fields.description: Display-only field showing the Requester__c (Contact) from the retrieved ChangeRequest record

fields.name: crReceivedDate
fields.description: Display-only field showing the Received_Date__c from the retrieved ChangeRequest record

fields.name: crContract
fields.description: Display-only field showing the Contract__c from the retrieved ChangeRequest record

fields.name: scopeType
fields.description: Input field for reviewer to select scope type (원계약 범위 or 추가변경). User provides data, so mapped_to_field is null. References Scope_Original_Contract and Scope_Additional_Change choices.

variables.name: recordId
variables.description: Input variable that receives the ChangeRequest record Id when the flow is invoked
